summary: V6.20 backend regression: 15/15 pytest pass for the new Cut D + bug fixes + Surprise Bag PBP auto-post stack. Admin /api/admin/repair-dnd-states 200 for admin / 403 for player (Aurora). Creation Tree returns canonical 3-pillar schema with 18 cross-pillar links + populated grouping. Creation Myth POST/GET/DELETE round-trip works (player blocked 403). Codex Links POST validates weight 1-10 (422 on 99) and color hex regex (422 on 'notacolor'); created edge listed and deleted cleanly. Surprise Bag draw + Scene-Break draw both return `posted_to_session` flag (false because no in-progress session — silent no-op confirmed) and strip _id from drawn doc. Login flow works (Sign In → /app). Did not exercise the World Tree UI inside a specific campaign view due to time budget — main agent should self-test by navigating to a campaign's atelier and clicking World Tree subtab.

rca of the issue: Bug #3 (Dnd5eBuilder .includes() crash) RCA: legacy/converter-imported dnd_state docs were missing saving_throw_profs / skill_profs arrays AND ability_scores keys. Fix shipped in three layers: (a) conversion_engine._hydrate_dnd_state() ensures all arrays + 6 ability scores ≥1 on every cross-system convert, (b) /admin/repair-dnd-states backfills existing docs (3 repaired during dev, verified via test_admin_succeeds), (c) Dnd5eBuilder.jsx defensive defaults on load. Bug #1 (0/-5 modifiers) and Bug #2 (-15 EP) fixed in DndSheetView.jsx by defaulting absent ability scores to 10 and clamping ep_current with Math.max(0, ...). Backend tests cover the repair endpoint; sheet-render fixes are pure-frontend defaults — recommend a Playwright snapshot in next iteration once main agent confirms the World Tree UI also renders for a campaign view.
